locations.name: Sügisene koduterrass
locations.description: Cozy wooden porch on a sunny autumn day, warm yellow wooden floor, small wooden craft table in the center, two small wooden chairs, colorful autumn trees with orange and red leaves visible in the background, warm sunlight streaming in. Simple clean cartoon style.

pages.scene: Kass Miisu in a light blue sweater and Koer Kusti in blue overalls are standing together on a cozy sunny wooden porch. In the background, colorful autumn trees with red and orange leaves are visible. Miisu and Kusti are smiling cheerfully at each other. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti kneel on the grass in the garden just below the wooden porch steps, picking up large brown pinecones from the ground covered in yellow leaves. Miisu holds a large pinecone in her hands and smiles. There is no tree or plant on the porch; the porch floor is empty apart from the craft table and chairs. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater.

Koer Kusti in blue overalls carries a small basket full of pinecones and places it on the wooden craft table on the porch. Kass Miisu stands next to the wooden table, clapping her hands excitedly. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater.

Kass Miisu sits on a small wooden chair at the craft table on the porch, carefully gluing two small craft eyes onto a large pinecone. Koer Kusti leans on the table, watching with a curious smile. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater.

Koer Kusti sits at the wooden table on the porch and, with his own paws, ties a long orange yarn string to the back end of the pinecone that has two googly eyes, so the pinecone now has a long orange yarn tail lying on the table. Kass Miisu sits next to him with empty paws and smiles brightly. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater. Kass Miisu has her own normal short white fluffy cat tail; she has no yarn on her body. The yellow wooden porch floor is painted in full detail all the way down to the very bottom edge of the picture.

On the wooden craft table on the sunny porch stands one cute handcrafted pinecone animal: a single brown pinecone body with two small googly craft eyes and a long orange yarn tail hanging from its back. There is no other figure or toy on top of it. Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti sit at the table and look at the pinecone animal with happy expressions. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater. Kass Miisu has her own normal short white fluffy cat tail; she has no yarn on her body. The yellow wooden porch floor is painted in full detail all the way down to the very bottom edge of the picture.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti are sitting together at the wooden table on the sunny porch, busy crafting more pinecone creatures. Five more brown pinecone animals, each with two googly eyes and a long orange yarn tail, sit in a neat row on the same craft table. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater. Kass Miisu has her own normal short white fluffy cat tail; she has no yarn on her body. The yellow wooden porch floor is painted in full detail all the way down to the very bottom edge of the picture.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti gently hold and move the little pinecone animals (plain brown pinecones, each with two googly eyes and a long orange yarn tail; they are crafts, not real animals) on the wooden craft table, playing a fun game together. Warm autumn sunlight glows on the porch, creating a happy and peaceful scene. Koer Kusti is a brown dog with plain brown floppy ears, wearing blue denim overalls with yellow buttons and a blue-and-white checked flat cap; no shoes. Kass Miisu is a white cat with green eyes in a light blue knitted sweater. Kass Miisu has her own normal short white fluffy cat tail; she has no yarn on her body. The yellow wooden porch floor is painted in full detail all the way down to the very bottom edge of the picture.
